title: Topic 1: Introductions & Greetings - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Greet people, introduce yourself, use basic courtesy phrases

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record yourself. Say hello and introduce yourself.
Say 3 things:
1. A greeting (Hello / Good morning)
2. Your name (My name is...)
3. How you are (I am fine...)
Example: Hello! My name is Pedro. I am fine, thank you.

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic01_introductions.txt, Lesson 1.4. XP 15 on submit, +10 on approval.
